estimate_interpretation.sapphire_factor_basis: Earlier healthy CIFAR CPU cases were about 1.3-1.5 times slower on Sapphire than the interactive probe node; 1.5 is an allowance, not a middle-CNN Sapphire measurement.
estimate_interpretation.historical_outlier_basis: The earlier model had an approximately 257-second first epoch on a pathological node; this allowance makes short-job requests conservative. That node also stayed slow, so this allowance does not guarantee completion on a persistently pathological node.
estimate_interpretation.pilot_limit: One-epoch probes establish shapes, method execution and initial resources; they do not establish long-run timing, memory or accuracy. Monitor actual screen/full array histories and retain any resource-failure provenance.
estimate_interpretation.memory_basis: Largest probe worker RSS is about 1.21 GiB; the previous standalone array including launcher peaked around 1.49 GiB. A 3G task request leaves substantial headroom without repeating the pooled job memory request per task.
estimate_interpretation.array_budget: Initial concurrency 12 uses 24 CPUs. Raising the cap requires accounting for other active jobs and the available CPU budget; the per-task request remains two CPUs.
estimate_interpretation.scientific_comparison: The CPU flush-denormal policy is explicitly true for every method and training law in this architecture.
